FFmpeg native movie playback

Copyright belongs to the FFmpeg authors.
The default Bink-only Windows x64 SDK uses unmodified FFmpeg sources at
29e619e767cde9045a75c29bc9a8278ae7b3a98b, under LGPL 2.1 or later.
See the accompanying LICENSE.txt and BUILD-CONFIG.txt for this SDK.

Source archive:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/archive/29e619e767cde9045a75c29bc9a8278ae7b3a98b.tar.gz
Source SHA256:
8e4699bcb6a311772e8f513cc72ce27328891b82a598b82e7cff3dfe580875a0

Build recipe: tools/build_ffmpeg_windows.py in the Arcanum CE source tree.
It enables Bink video, Bink RDFT/DCT audio, local file input, swscale and
swresample. SIMD optimizations and runtime CPU detection remain enabled.
No external codec libraries, encoder, network protocol or hardware decoder
is included. GNU Make and NASM are build tools, not runtime dependencies.

The libraries remain replaceable shared components. ARCANUM_FFMPEG_ROOT can
select another ABI-compatible SDK; its own accompanying license takes precedence.
No Bink DLL or proprietary decoder is included in this backend.
